whatWasMeasured: Nothing of its own: this file books no package's bytes (ownBytes 0). Each item of sharedPoolBytes is a measured change of the chapters route that is no package's own, recorded under items with the build it was measured on. Only this file may book a negative item (ruling O1), for what merging packages saves together (ruling N1: stub bytes are not additive). The lead's merge check (rc44-s0-readings.mjs assertBookingsAddUp, S0's suite block 'O1 the bookings add up') holds that on a build the chapters route less the integrated base is every size file's own bytes plus the shared pool's, exactly.
